'''Matt Moseley''' (forum handle '''LtPage2''') co-founded [[Holotable]] with [[Rustan Sharer]] in September 2004 and was its sole developer.<ref name="htabout2012" /> He is named as copyright holder on the [[Holotable]] readme for 2004&ndash;2007.<ref name="readme">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071123231323/http://www.holotable.com/readme.php Holotable readme], holotable.com (Wayback, 23 November 2007). Copyright 2004&ndash;2007 Matt Moseley.</ref> A 2 December 2014 Holotable news post is signed Matt.<ref name="ht2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141217162132/http://www.holotable.com/ holotable.com homepage], Wayback 17 December 2014. News dated 12/2/14.</ref>
